result:
Round 65 (the project BPM field and the bars/beats ruler) passes my independent check, and I tested it in a real browser (`browserVerified: true`). I found no bugs, and it is ready for root to commit: the same 6 paths A changed, HEAD still `f9d768c`.

**Offline checks (re-run myself):**
- **Tree:** the 424 frozen files and the 4 protected files are unchanged. All 6 owned files use LF line endings.
- **Code:** the StudioWorkspace diff contains exactly the four allowed edits plus the two imports. The new tempo code is pure, and the ruler strip only receives the timeline length, zoom and BPM. The user-facing texts match the spec exactly.
- **Red run:** with the tempo files removed, both new test files fail first.
- **Mutations:** all 14 required mutations (a–n) make their named tests fail, and so do four extra ones I added.
- **Gates:** `npm run verify` exits 0 on the first try, with 91 files / 1605 tests and 0 timeouts. Biome on `./app` is 4 errors / 218 warnings / 1 info, the baseline, and 0 on the owned files.

**Browser checks (standalone Playwright for real mouse/keyboard, gstack `/browse` for the anonymous and protection checks):**
- **Audio is never stretched:**
  - Fixture: Soft impact at 4 s and Middle East at 7 s, both added by real drag-and-drop.
  - Four real WAV exports (no BPM twice, then 90, then 120) are byte-identical: same sha256, 5,200,896 frames, sound starting exactly at 4.000 s.
  - With video muted, playback from 3 s shows the sound effect starting at 4.131 s with no BPM and 4.009 s at 90 BPM, both inside the ±0.15 s limit.
- **The BPM field and ruler** behave as specified at both 1440×900 and 1280×720:
  - empty by default, with the hint text;
  - bars land at the right pixel positions for 90 and 120 BPM;
  - comma decimals (`92,5`), Escape and clearing the field work as specified;
  - invalid values (`1000`, `abc`, `19`) are refused with the exact message;
  - shortcuts are ignored while typing, and a click inside the field doesn't commit a half-typed value;
  - labels thin out when zoomed out and beat labels appear when zoomed in;
  - a BPM change never appears in Undo;
  - the layout doesn't shift, and Snap still lands on whole seconds rather than bar lines.
- **Neighbouring behaviour:** I re-checked the loading-item ruling (no drag while it loads; ready after 3.2 s, then it drops normally), the seconds ruler's click/drag/double-click, focus release on lane and clip clicks, and hydration warnings. All pass.
- **Anonymous access and purchase protection:** the demo opens with no login, directly and through the header link. `/studio/middle-east` asks for sign-in. The token endpoint returns 401 anonymously and 403 with a fake token. The demo page makes no R2, token or download requests.

**Things to know before relying on this:**
- A few early browser attempts failed because of my own test scripts (a rounded zoom value used as exact, and a wrong expected field value). I fixed the scripts and replaced those attempts within the measurement budget; the report lists each one.
- The spec asks for byte-identical exports, while an older test rule says byte identity can't be relied on. The exports were identical anyway, so this didn't change the result; I recorded both measures.
- My request filter didn't recognise the real R2 proxy address. A separate load listing every request address confirmed the demo page makes no R2 requests.

**Notes for B, none of them bugs:**
- The "999 is the maximum" mutation is only caught because A added `999.5` to the tests, which is outside the frozen lists. B should adopt it into the spec.
- One ruler double-click out of 9 didn't zoom to fit, and I couldn't reproduce it.
- One render-budget test failed once while the machine was under mutation load; clean runs were all green.
- Clicking a focused grid dropdown keeps its focus, as intended, but no test covers it.
- The anonymous demo page now stores a cart session id in localStorage; it isn't a login credential.
- The no-BPM playback start of 4.131 s is close to the limit because the level meter is only sampled every ~20 ms or so; the export itself starts exactly at 4.000 s.

Not run, all out of this round's scope: video sync and the "fit video" step, the full FB-01..FB-16 regression, and root's e2e smoke. The Tech Lead's hands-on check (R65-T) is open. It covers A's two gaps: the 16 px input height and the hint that scrolls off-screen. The report also carries the open items from `root-pre-push-review.md` and `publication-checkpoint.json`, including the pending push of `f9d768c` to `shavidze/czaba-store`.
